qEn: Which of the following is the longest river in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
explainEn: The Ganga is the longest river originating within India, with a total length of over 2,500 km.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद समानता के अधिकार से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Articles 14 to 18 of the Indian Constitution guarantee the Right to Equality.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance/festival associated with which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित एक पारंपरिक नृत्य/उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam celebrated in the Assamese calendar months.

qEn: Which planet in our solar system is known as the Red Planet?
qHi: हमारे सौरमंडल में किस ग्रह को लाल ग्रह के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Mars is called the Red Planet because of the iron oxide prevalent on its surface.

qEn: The headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is located in:
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
explainEn: The central office of the Reserve Bank of India has been permanently located in Mumbai since 1937.

qEn: Which vitamin is abundantly found in citrus fruits like lemon and orange?
qHi: नींबू और संतरे जैसे खट्टे फलों में प्रचुर मात्रा में कौन सा विटामिन पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of Vitamin C, which is essential for growth and repair of tissues.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution defines the right to equality before law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता के अधिकार को परिभाषित करता है?
explainEn: Article 14 of the Indian Constitution states that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws.

qEn: The famous monument Gateway of India is located in which city?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध स्मारक गेटवे ऑफ़ इंडिया किस शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Gateway of India is an arch-monument built during the 20th century in Mumbai.

qEn: Who was the first Indian woman to go into space?
qHi: अंतरिक्ष में जाने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला कौन थीं?
explainEn: Kalpana Chawla was an American astronaut and engineer who was the first woman of Indian origin to go to space.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance and festival associated with which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित एक पारंपरिक नृत्य और उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam and represents the folk dance associated with it.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measurement for electrical resistance?
qHi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध की माप की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The ohm is the SI unit of electrical resistance, named after physicist Georg Ohm.

qEn: Which of the following mountain passes connects Srinagar with Leh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा श्रीनगर को लेह से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Zoji La is a high mountain pass in Ladakh, situated on the Srinagar-Leh highway in the Himalayan mountain range.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: The Tropic of Cancer passes through which of the following groups of Indian states?
qHi: कर्क रेखा निम्नलिखित में से किस भारतीय राज्य समूह से होकर गुजरती है?
optsEn: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Tripura
optsHi: उत्तर प्रदेश, मध्य प्रदेश, बिहार, त्रिपुरा
explainEn: The Tropic of Cancer (23.30° N) passes through eight Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Geography - Contemporary India I

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the appointment of the Prime Minister and other Ministers?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद प्रधानमंत्री और अन्य मंत्रियों की नियुक्ति का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 75 of the Indian Constitution states that the Prime Minister shall be appointed by the President and the other Ministers shall be appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.

qEn: During whose viceroyalty was the Vernacular Press Act enacted in 1878?
qHi: किस वायसराय के कार्यकाल के दौरान 1878 में वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट पारित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Vernacular Press Act of 1878 was enacted during the viceroyalty of Lord Lytton to curtail the freedom of the Indian-language press.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which of the following is the highest waterfall in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से भारत का सबसे ऊँचा जलप्रपात कौन सा है?
explainEn: Kunchikal Falls, located in the Shimoga district of Karnataka, is the highest waterfall in India, formed by the Varahi river.

qEn: What is the primary gas responsible for the greenhouse effect on the planet Venus?
qHi: शुक्र ग्रह पर ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव के लिए उत्तरदायी मुख्य गैस कौन सी है?
explainEn: The atmosphere of Venus is composed of about 96.5% carbon dioxide, which creates a runaway greenhouse effect making it the hottest planet.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 6 Geography - The Earth in Our Solar System

qEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought in which year?
qHi: बक्सर का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought on October 22, 1764, between the British forces led by Hector Munro and the combined army of Mir Kasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, and Shah Alam II.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 8 History - Our Pasts III

qEn: Which organelle in a plant cell is responsible for photosynthesis?
qHi: पादप कोशिका का कौन सा अंगक प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll which absorbs sunlight and carries out photosynthesis in plant cells.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Science - Fundamental Unit of Life

qEn: Which of the following is a Kharif crop in India?
qHi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक खरीफ फसल है?
explainEn: Paddy is a major Kharif crop sown during the monsoon season in India.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the right to equality before law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता के अधिकार से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Article 14 of the Constitution of India guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measuring atmospheric pressure?
qHi: वायुमंडलीय दबाव मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: Pascal is the SI unit of pressure, including atmospheric pressure.

qEn: In which state is the Gir National Park located?
qHi: गीर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the state of Gujarat and is famous for Asiatic lions.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: Which river basin is the Bhakra Nangal Dam built across?
qHi: भाखड़ा नांगल बांध किस नदी बेसिन पर बनाया गया है?
explainEn: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is constructed on the Sutlej River.

qEn: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
qHi: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
explainEn: The Chief Justice of India and other judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President of India.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily obtained from sunlight by the human body?
qHi: मानव शरीर द्वारा धूप से मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विटामिन प्राप्त किया जाता है?
explainEn: Vitamin D is synthesized in the skin upon exposure to sunlight.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Finance Commission?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद वित्त आयोग की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 280 of the Constitution of India provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body constituted by the President.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty?
qHi: सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
explainEn: Simukha was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty in the 1st century BCE.

qEn: The Barail Range is located in which part of India?
qHi: बराईल श्रेणी भारत के किस भाग में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Barail Range is a hill range running from Assam to Manipur through Nagaland in North-East India.

qEn: Which constitutional amendment Act reduced the voting age from 21 years to 18 years in India?
qHi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा भारत में मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष की गई?
explainEn: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies from 21 to 18 years.

qEn: Badminton World Federation (BWF) headquarters is located in which country?
qHi: बैडमिंटन वर्ल्ड फेडरेशन (BWF) का मुख्यालय किस देश में स्थित है?
explainEn: The headquarters of the Badminton World Federation is located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
sourceHint: Official BWF statutes and Olympic governing bodies directory

qEn: Which chemical compound is commonly known as Blue Vitriol?
qHi: किस रासायनिक यौगिक को सामान्यतः नीला थोथा (Blue Vitriol) कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate is commonly known as blue vitriol.

qEn: Which of the following Fundamental Rights cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency under the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी निम्नलिखित में से किस मौलिक अधिकार को निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: By the 44th Amendment Act, Articles 20 (protection in respect of conviction for offenses) and 21 (protection of life and personal liberty) cannot be suspended during a National Emergency.

qEn: What is the standard unit of SI for measuring thermodynamic temperature?
qHi: ऊष्मप्रवैगिक तापमान को मापने के लिए एसआई की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: Kelvin is the base unit of thermodynamic temperature in the International System of Units (SI).

qEn: Which vitamins are water-soluble in human nutrition?
qHi: मानव पोषण में कौन से विटामिन पानी में घुलनशील हैं?
explainEn: Vitamin B-complex and Vitamin C are water-soluble, whereas Vitamins A, D, E, and K are fat-soluble.

qEn: Which Harappan site is famous for its dockyard?
qHi: कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल अपने गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Lothal, located in Gujarat, is well known for the discovery of a massive tidal dockyard.

qEn: What is the chemical formula for ordinary table salt?
qHi: साधारण नमक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Sodium chloride, with the chemical formula NaCl, is the salt commonly used as table salt.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer known as 'Sandhivigrahika' was responsible for which of the following portfolios?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, 'संधिविग्रहिक' के रूप में जाने जाने वाले अधिकारी की जिम्मेदारी निम्नलिखित में से किस विभाग की थी?
optsEn: Chief Justice of the supreme court
explainEn: In the Gupta administration, Sandhivigrahika was the minister for war and peace, responsible for foreign affairs and framing peace treaties.

qEn: Who among the following founded the Atmiya Sabha in the year 1815?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने वर्ष 1815 में आत्मीय सभा की स्थापना ਕੀਤੀ थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Atmiya Sabha in 1815 as a philosophical discussion circle in Kolkata to campaign against social evils.

qEn: What is the chemical formula of the compound commonly known as washing soda?
qHi: सामान्यतः वाशिंग सोडा (धोने का सोडा) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले यौगिक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate, chemically represented as Na2CO3.10H2O.

qEn: Which of the following biosphere reserves is located in the state of Meghalaya?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जीवमंडल आरक्षित क्षेत्र (बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व) मेघालय राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in the West Garo Hills district of Meghalaya.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, India

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the abolition of untouchability?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता के अंत से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Constitution of India abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

qEn: What is the standard meridian of India?
qHi: भारत की मानक मध्याह्न रेखा कौन सी है?
explainEn: The 82.5 degree East longitude passing through Mirzapur is taken as the Standard Meridian of India.

qEn: Which vitamin deficiency causes scurvy?
qHi: किस विटामिन की कमी से स्कर्वी रोग होता है?
explainEn: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C, which is commonly found in citrus fruits.

qEn: Which instrument is used to measure atmospheric pressure?
qHi: वायुमंडलीय दबाव मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: A barometer is a scientific instrument used in meteorology to measure atmospheric pressure.

qEn: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
qHi: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757 between the British East India Company and the Nawab of Bengal.

qEn: Which mountain range separates the Indo-Gangetic Plain from the Deccan Plateau?
qHi: कौन सी पर्वत श्रृंखला भारत-गंगा के मैदान को दक्कन के पठार से अलग करती है?
explainEn: The Vindhya range traditionally marks the boundary between the northern Indo-Gangetic plains and the southern Deccan plateau.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Maurya Empire in ancient India?
qHi: प्राचीन भारत में मौर्य साम्राज्य के संस्थापक कौन थे?
explainEn: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with the help of Chanakya by overthrowing the Nanda Dynasty.

qEn: Which wind system brings rainfall to the majority of India during the summer months?
qHi: ग्रीष्मकालीन महीनों में भारत के अधिकांश हिस्से में कौन सी पवन प्रणाली वर्षा लाती है?
explainEn: The South-West Monsoon is the primary rain-bearing wind system affecting the Indian subcontinent during summer.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: In which year was the first session of the Indian National Congress held?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का प्रथम अधिवेशन किस वर्ष आयोजित किया गया था?
explainEn: The first session of the Indian National Congress was held in Bombay in December 1885, presided over by W.C. Bonnerjee.

qEn: Which chemical element has the highest electrical conductivity at room temperature?
qHi: कमरे के तापमान पर किस रासायनिक तत्व की विद्युत चालकता सबसे अधिक होती है?
explainEn: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and reflectivity of any metal.

qEn: Which of the following biosphere reserves was the first to be established in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व भारत में स्थापित होने वाला पहला था?
explainEn: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve was established in 1986 as India's first biosphere reserve.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
